purpose: Measure how closely frozen CoverageDLGN Legacy V4 on the nine-channel LogicTreeNet-M architecture approaches the reported 71.01% test accuracy.

architecture.input_encoding: three fixed uniform thermometer thresholds per RGB channel; nine Boolean channels

training.residual_initialization: probability 0.951, corresponding to paper z3 approximately 5

protocol_notes: The paper specifies validation every 2000 steps but does not state its total epoch count in prose; its long-training plots extend to approximately 1000 epochs.
350000 steps is the largest multiple of the paper's 2000-step evaluation interval below 1000 local effective epochs (351000 steps).

Standard crop/flip augmentation is retained from the existing nine-channel V4 pilot to maximize the one-seed accuracy probe; it is an explicit adaptation because the original paper does not document augmentation.
The held-out test set remains unused during training. After the run completes, freeze the best hardened-validation checkpoint and evaluate test exactly once.
This run measures our method only and does not provide a matched long-run random control.
